description: Norway: new companies, name changes, liquidations, bankruptcies, compulsory dissolutions, removals, registered-office (municipality) changes and industry changes in a date window, from the Brønnøysund Register Centre's open API and update feed. Event types: new_company, name_change, liquidation, bankruptcy, dissolution, removal, registered_office_change, industry_change. Same record shape as prh_company_events. Company-level data only: sole proprietorships (ENK) are withheld; no roles/persons, no street addresses, e-mail or phone. Source: Brreg Enhetsregisteret (NLOD 2.0).
